markdown.markdown:
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

folder_2025 <- "C:/Users/EliceoR/Desktop/Nixticuil/Leaflet/LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1"
folder_2024 <- "C:/Users/EliceoR/Desktop/Nixticuil/Leaflet/LC09_L2SP_029046_20240515_20240516_02_T1"
aoi_shp     <- "C:/Users/EliceoR/Desktop/Nixticuil/Nixticuil.shp"

# Cargar shapefile y reproyectar
nixticuil <- vect(aoi_shp)
nixticuil_wgs <- project(nixticuil, "EPSG:4326")

# Escala para bandas SR
scale_factor <- 0.0000275

# === POST-FIRE ===
b3_2025 <- rast(file.path(folder_2025, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1_SR_B3.TIF")) * scale_factor
b4_2025 <- rast(file.path(folder_2025, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1_SR_B4.TIF")) * scale_factor
b5_2025 <- rast(file.path(folder_2025, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1_SR_B5.TIF")) * scale_factor
b6_2025 <- rast(file.path(folder_2025, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1_SR_B6.TIF")) * scale_factor
b7_2025 <- rast(file.path(folder_2025, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20250502_20250503_02_T1_SR_B7.TIF")) * scale_factor

stacked_2025 <- c(b3_2025, b4_2025, b5_2025, b6_2025, b7_2025)
names(stacked_2025) <- c("B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7")
stacked_crop_2025 <- crop(stacked_2025, nixticuil) %>% mask(nixticuil)

# Índices post-incendio
ndvi <- (stacked_crop_2025$B5 - stacked_crop_2025$B4) / (stacked_crop_2025$B5 + stacked_crop_2025$B4)
nbr  <- (stacked_crop_2025$B5 - stacked_crop_2025$B7) / (stacked_crop_2025$B5 + stacked_crop_2025$B7)
ndwi <- (stacked_crop_2025$B3 - stacked_crop_2025$B5) / (stacked_crop_2025$B3 + stacked_crop_2025$B5)
msi  <- stacked_crop_2025$B6 / stacked_crop_2025$B5

# === PRE-FIRE ===
b5_2024 <- rast(file.path(folder_2024, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20240515_20240516_02_T1_SR_B5.TIF")) * scale_factor
b7_2024 <- rast(file.path(folder_2024, "LC09_L2SP_029046_20240515_20240516_02_T1_SR_B7.TIF")) * scale_factor
b5_2024 <- crop(b5_2024, nixticuil) %>% mask(nixticuil)
b7_2024 <- crop(b7_2024, nixticuil) %>% mask(nixticuil)
nbr_2024 <- (b5_2024 - b7_2024) / (b5_2024 + b7_2024)

# dNBR y reproyección
dnbr <- nbr_2024 - nbr
dnbr <- clamp(dnbr, lower = -1, upper = 1, values = TRUE)
dnbr <- mask(dnbr, nixticuil)

# Clasificación de severidad
dnbr_class <- classify(dnbr, rcl = matrix(c(-1, -0.05, 1,
                                            -0.05, 0.1, 2,
                                             0.1, 0.2, 3,
                                             0.2, 0.27, 4,
                                             0.27, 0.35, 5,
                                             0.35, 1, 6),
                                          ncol=3, byrow=TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)
dnbr_class[is.na(dnbr)] <- NA

# Asignar etiquetas
levels(dnbr_class) <- data.frame(value = 1:6,
                                 label = c("Aumento vegetación", "Sin cambio", "Baja",
                                           "Moderada-baja", "Moderada-alta", "Alta"))

# Reproyectar a WGS84
dnbr_wgs       <- project(dnbr, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
dnbr_class_wgs <- project(dnbr_class, "EPSG:4326", method = "near")
levels(dnbr_class_wgs) <- levels(dnbr_class)
ndvi_wgs       <- project(ndvi, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
nbr_wgs        <- project(nbr,  "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
ndwi_wgs       <- project(ndwi, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
msi_wgs        <- project(msi,  "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")

# Paletas
dnbr_values <- values(dnbr_class_wgs)
dnbr_values <- dnbr_values[!is.na(dnbr_values)]

ndvi_pal  <- colorNumeric("RdYlGn", domain = values(ndvi_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), na.color = "transparent")
nbr_pal   <- colorNumeric("RdYlGn", domain = values(nbr_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), na.color = "transparent")
ndwi_pal  <- colorNumeric("Blues", domain = values(ndwi_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), na.color = "transparent")
msi_pal   <- colorNumeric("Oranges", domain = values(msi_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), na.color = "transparent")
dnbr_pal  <- colorNumeric("magma", domain = values(dnbr_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), na.color = "transparent")
dnbr_class_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("darkgreen", "lightgreen", "yellow", "orange", "red", "darkred"),
  domain = dnbr_values,
  na.color = "transparent"
)


# Información complementaria en tabla para visualización externa
sat_info <- data.frame(
  Categoria = c("Imagenes utilizadas", " ", "Resolución", "Sistema de referencia", "Índices calculados"),
  Detalle = c("2024-05-15 (Landsat 9)",
              "2025-05-02 (Landsat 9)",
              "30 metros",
              "WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)",
              "NDVI, NBR, dNBR, MSI")
)

# Mostrar tabla en Quarto o R Markdown fuera del mapa
knitr::kable(sat_info, caption = "Metadatos del análisis satelital")

# Visualización Leaflet
leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Satélite (Esri)")%>%
  #addRasterImage(ndvi_wgs, colors = ndvi_pal, opacity = 1, group = "NDVI") %>%
  addRasterImage(nbr_wgs, colors = nbr_pal, opacity = 1, group = "Salud vegetativa (NDVI)") %>%
  #addRasterImage(ndwi_wgs, colors = ndwi_pal, opacity = 1, group = "NDWI") %>%
  addRasterImage(msi_wgs, colors = msi_pal, opacity = 1, group = "Húmedad del Suelo") %>%
  addRasterImage(dnbr_wgs, colors = dnbr_pal, opacity = 1, group = "Área afectadas por incendio") %>%
  addRasterImage(dnbr_class_wgs, colors = dnbr_class_pal, opacity = 1, group = "Severidad por incendio", project = FALSE) %>%
  addPolygons(data = st_as_sf(nixticuil_wgs), color = "blue", weight = 2, fillOpacity = 0, group = "Polígono Nixticuil") %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomleft", pal = dnbr_pal, values = values(dnbr_wgs, na.rm = TRUE), title = "Área afectadas por incendio", group = "Área afectadas por incendio") %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomleft", pal = nbr_pal, values = values(nbr_wgs , na.rm = TRUE), title = "Salud vegetativa (NDVI)", group = "Salud vegetativa (NDVI)") %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = dnbr_class_pal, values = dnbr_values, title = "Severidad por incendio", group = "Severidad por incendio") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Polígono Nixticuil", "Salud vegetativa (NDVI)", "Húmedad del Suelo", "Área afectadas por incendio", "Severidad por incendio"),
    position = "topright",
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, autoZIndex = TRUE)
  )

```
